sources.title: Ivanhoe copper output jumps 19% as Kamoa-Kakula rebounds
evidence: Ivanhoe Mines (TSX: IVN) reported its copper production for the third quarter totaled 76,401 tonnes,
Mining rates increased by 30% to more than 700,000 tonnes per month,
At the end of the third quarter, Kamoa-Kakula had approximately 43,000 tonnes of copper in inventory.
The complex’s 500,000 tonnes-per-annum copper smelter is operating at 60% capacity,
Ivanhoe maintained its 2026 production guidance of 290,000 to 310,000 tonnes of copper in saleable copper products,

sources.title: INSIGHT: Global overcapacity, legal risks weigh on LG Chem’s chemicals business
evidence: LG Chem is set to restart its 900,000 tonne/year Yeosu Naphtha Cracking Center No 2 plant on 12 October
The facility – which accounted for W2.49 trillion in LG Chem’s annual sales, or 5.09% of group revenue
The company said it plans to “resume operations promptly once feedstock supply stabilizes”

sources.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens as US Gulf Coast prepares for landfall
evidence: About 63% of current oil production in the Gulf, or 1.3 million barrels of oil a day, has been shut in
Just over 1.1 billion cubic feet a day of natural gas production has also been shut in, or about 57% of total output
On Wednesday, 25% of oil production and 16% of natural gas output had been shut in.
Isaias was forecast to strengthen to near Category 3 intensity, with sustained winds reaching 110 mph (175 kph) on Friday
About 9 million barrels of oil production could be lost across the Gulf through the duration of the storm,
In Florida, officials ordered mandatory evacuations beginning at noon local time on Thursday
